title: Rivery River Freshness SLA
app: Rivery river run events via the Rivery API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=rivery:run status="Completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by river_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Rivery river and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A river can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Rivery.
implementation: Ingest Rivery success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical river exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of river by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Rivery has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
